name: incident-report
state: At 07:40, a mains interruption stopped the air handling fans in a training facility. The emergency lighting stayed on. Power to the control room was restored automatically at 07:44. The operator, who was still in the briefing room, remotely checked the status panel from a mobile terminal. It showed that the fans remained stopped. The automatic restart option had been intentionally disabled on Monday while the maintenance team inspected the pressure sensors. A new event was logged at 08:01 when the maintenance team finished checking the sensors. The security desk continued taking calls and receiving visitors throughout the event. At 08:10, the operator went to the control room and enabled each fan from the local panel after checking its current draw. The briefing room thermometer briefly showed a two-degree increase. The evening handoff initially said all normal equipment had resumed immediately after mains power returned. The engineer's corrected handoff notes that the status panel and sensor inspection did not restart the fans. They were restored in a later step by the operator.

question.instructions: Which event directly restored the air handling fans?

criteria.mains: Automatic restoration of mains power at 07:44
criteria.manual: Operator enabled the fans from the local panel at 08:10

name: debate
state: The council considered a plan to close Cedar Street to cars during the summer festival. Ravi said he wanted street vendors to stay in the same positions because the town had already issued a printed map. Elena objected that people who use wheelchairs would have difficulty reaching the information booth if it stayed on the steep upper block. Her proposal moved only the information booth to the flat block by the library. Jade suggested moving the sound stage indoors because of complaints about evening noise. Robin noted that the festival budget already included signs for temporary street closure, but did not ask for a change to either the booth or the stage. The chair grouped the indoor stage and booth relocation into separate motions. The booth relocation motion was discussed first. The record includes the concern about the steep block even though the booth ultimately remained in place.

question.instructions: Who raised the accessibility concern about the information booth?
